intendedUse: Owner-authorized prototype bare-PCB fabrication of the frozen Rev A0 wand and, only after its open EDA/CAM gate passes, the independent receiver-effects board; prototype 3D printing and controlled cross-domain bring-up remain allowed, while PCBA and production remain locked.
prohibitedUses: Production release or sale before every physical, target-firmware, receiver, PCBA, security and independent-review gate passes
PCBA ordering before supplier and LCSC mapping, exact component substitutions and assembly data are independently reviewed
Uploading or ordering any receiver-effects Gerber/drill/CAM created before the current power-width and return-path rework; every prior receiver-effects CAM package is REJECTED
Connecting a battery before exact protected-cell selection and J2 harness pin-order and polarity verification
Using conductive carbon-fiber or metal rod material inside or adjacent to the antenna keepout

requirements.statement: The authoritative wand PCB shall remain a 15.0 mm by 80.0 mm, 4-layer design with its frozen source identity and zero-error ERC/DRC tool results preserved before fabrication.
requirements.verificationMethod: Verify the bound KiCad board identity, then replay the pinned ERC/DRC and land-pattern checks after any electrical or layout change.

requirements.statement: PCB, mounting holes, USB-C and press-to-arm controls shall align to the enclosure under case_x = pcb_x - 7.5 and case_z = pcb_y + 9.0 without reserved-volume collisions.
requirements.verificationMethod: Replay enclosure geometry QA and then inspect and measure the first printed article with the real PCB installed.

requirements.statement: The enclosure shall reserve a maximum 11 x 6 x 42 mm protected 1S LiPo with 10k NTC, service access, wire bend space and a J2 JST-SH 1.0 mm 3-pin BAT+/NTC/GND interface; J2 harness polarity shall be verified before connection.
requirements.verificationMethod: Replay reserved-volume QA, select the exact protected cell and harness, continuity-check J2 and physically fit the pack before energized bring-up.

requirements.statement: The enclosure shall reserve a 10 mm diameter by 3.4 mm maximum coin LRA/ERM, retained nonconductively and wired to J3, while the selected actuator remains compatible with the DRV2605L configuration.
requirements.verificationMethod: Replay reserved-volume QA, review the selected actuator, physically fit it, then verify polarity, drive mode, current and thermal behavior on the first article.

requirements.statement: The case z=5..30 mm antenna keepout shall contain no battery, metal fastener, dense filler or conductive rod, with at least 11 mm battery-to-keepout and 5 mm haptic-to-keepout separation in the current geometry.
requirements.verificationMethod: Replay geometry checks, inspect materials and assembly, then perform target-powered RF range and coexistence testing.

requirements.statement: The armed wand shall recognize TAP, TWIST_CW, TWIST_CCW, SWISH_LEFT, SWISH_RIGHT, THRUST, CIRCLE_CW and CIRCLE_CCW, reject stationary and ambiguous motion and enforce a 250 ms refractory period. GESTURE_EVENT shall use an explicitly authenticated negotiated profile: Legacy V1 is exactly 2 bytes and channel 0 only; Multichannel V2 is exactly 14 bytes and requires ARM_ACTIVE plus outer/payload device-session binding.
requirements.verificationMethod: Run gesture and exact-length/profile host vectors, then build and exercise both NINA-B302 targets, collect representative-user data, prove real BLE/AES-CCM interoperability and show that rejected, unauthenticated, disarmed or cross-device/session events produce no media or dangerous output.

requirements.statement: The prototype fabrication upload shall contain only the verified Rev A0 bare-PCB Gerber/drill package for a 15 x 80 mm, 4-layer, 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer-copper board with black mask, white silkscreen, ENIG, tented vias and no impedance, edge-plating, castellations or gold fingers.
requirements.verificationMethod: Verify the bound ZIP identity and inspect the generated Gerber/drill set and JLC order parameters before upload.

requirements.statement: The first printed enclosure and first assembled wand PCB shall be physically inspected for fit, shrink compensation, fastener torque, USB/button access, battery/haptic retention, current-limited bring-up, charge, thermal and RF behavior.
requirements.verificationMethod: Record first-article measurements, photographs, torque, current, temperature, charge, USB, haptic and RF results against this configuration.

requirements.statement: A pinned nRF Connect SDK/Zephyr toolchain shall produce, flash and exercise a NINA-B302 target image implementing the host-reviewed gesture and protocol behavior.
requirements.verificationMethod: Record toolchain lock, clean target build, image hash, flash log and hardware-in-loop results.

requirements.statement: The receiver-effects runtime shall be a direct paired BLE endpoint with its own NINA-B302, keep eight isolated device/session/channel slots, map the eight gestures to eight media effects and default to media-only authority. It shall accept Legacy V1 only as exact 2-byte channel-0 compatibility and Multichannel V2 only as exact 14-byte explicitly authenticated profile with ARM_ACTIVE and device/session binding.
requirements.verificationMethod: Replay the bound host build, CTest, cppcheck and source-hash inventory, then run cross-device/profile, negative-security, timeout, slot-isolation, safe-state, display/audio and no-dangerous-output hardware-in-loop tests on the versioned target and board.

requirements.statement: The independent receiver-effects working PCB shall remain a 50.3 mm by 42.3 mm, 4-layer direct BLE endpoint using NINA-B302-00B-00, TPS62162DSGR, USBLC6-2SC6 and MAX98357AETE+T, with the external Waveshare 1.28inch GC9A01 SKU 19192 display and XHXDZ 30MM-4Ω3W-TFHM C50387216 BTL speaker. Existing receiver CAM is REJECTED and PCBA is not authorized.
requirements.verificationMethod: Complete the power-width, bounded-neckdown, plane-entry, return-path and CPL-origin rework; rerun ERC, native DRC, unconnected and schematic-parity checks; then regenerate and hash-bind a new bare-board CAM package before any upload. Keep the hardware/HIL and PCBA gates open.

requirements.statement: No PCBA or production build shall be ordered until exact BOM supplier/LCSC mapping, substitutions, CPL origin/rotation, component availability and assembly constraints are complete and independently reviewed.
requirements.verificationMethod: Review a versioned BOM/CPL/assembly package, supplier mappings and assembly DFM evidence before enabling PCBA or production release.

requirements.statement: Production release requires all technical and physical gates, representative-user gesture validation, packet-security and RF testing, receiver release and independent electrical, mechanical and security review to pass.
requirements.verificationMethod: Audit every gate and evidence binding, perform independent reviews, and explicitly change the production authorization and release locks only after closure.

subsystems.scope: Rev A0 wand PCB, power/charge path, NINA-B302, IMU, USB-C, press-to-arm input, J2 battery and J3 haptic interfaces.
Split printable shell, PCB carrier, rear cap, rod connector, plunger and the protected battery, haptic, service-wire and RF material reservations.
Eight-class gesture classifier, physical arm gate, refractory logic, exact Legacy V1/Multichannel V2 profile boundary and NINA-B302 target integration boundary.
Verified JLC-compatible frozen-wand bare-PCB upload plus the still-open receiver-effects CAM, PCBA and production handoff.

Direct NINA-B302 receiver-effects endpoint with eight isolated slots, eight media effects, explicit V1/V2 profiles, display/audio scheduling and a media-only no-dangerous-output boundary. Host logic is tool-verified; target, PCB/CAM, HIL and physical evidence remain open.

artifacts.kind: JLC bare-PCB Gerber and drill upload package
Receiver-side protocol and profile boundary specification
Receiver runtime, multichannel routing, media renderer/audio and fail-closed host-verification record
Receiver-effects KiCad working source; prior CAM rejected and current CAM rework open

interfaces.contract: The enclosure consumes the authoritative PCB coordinate frame and preserves the board, mounting, USB-C and press-to-arm locations under one frozen transform.

parameters.name: pcbEnvelope
parameters.tolerance: enclosure allowance 0.25 mm unless physically recalibrated

interfaces.contract: The shell retains and services one exact protected 1S LiPo inside the reserved envelope and delivers BAT+, 10k NTC and GND to J2 only after harness verification.

parameters.name: connector
parameters.value: J2 JST-SH 1.0 mm 3-pin BAT+/NTC/GND; NTC reaches pin 2; verify numbering and harness polarity before connection

interfaces.contract: J3 drives an exactly selected DRV2605L-compatible coin actuator retained in the upper-shell nonconductive cup without PCB, battery or shell collision.

parameters.name: retention
parameters.value: printed upper-shell cup plus thin nonconductive foam

interfaces.contract: The mechanical stack preserves the NINA antenna volume and uses nonconductive nearby materials until target RF evidence establishes performance.

parameters.name: forbiddenContents
parameters.value: battery, metal fasteners, dense filler, conductive carbon-fiber or metal rod

parameters.name: preferredRod
parameters.value: 8 mm solid GFRP, 195 mm cut length

interfaces.contract: The portable host-reviewed logic shall be integrated on the NINA-B302 without changing the gesture frame, arm gate, classifier thresholds or protocol semantics without re-verification.

parameters.name: target
parameters.value: u-blox NINA-B302 / nRF52 with pinned nRF Connect SDK and Zephyr

parameters.name: gestureFrame
parameters.value: wand +X tip-forward, +Y user-left, +Z arm-button-up after calibrated sensor remap

interfaces.contract: The direct receiver-effects BLE endpoint consumes only an explicitly authenticated negotiated GESTURE_EVENT profile as media intent. Profile, exact length, ARM state, route channel and device/session binding are checked before an event reaches display/audio scheduling; receipt never grants dangerous-output authority.

parameters.name: profileNegotiation
parameters.value: explicit authenticated handshake; unsupported profile rejects; no length sniffing, automatic downgrade or mixed-profile session

parameters.name: multichannelV2
parameters.value: exactly 14 bytes big-endian; channel 0..7; ARM_ACTIVE and payload/outer device-session equality required

parameters.name: transportProtection
parameters.value: authenticated/encrypted target frame and replay persistence required; host copy-decrypt callbacks are not cryptographic evidence

parameters.name: receiverAuthority
parameters.value: media-only; display/audio never authorize dangerous output

interfaces.contract: Manufacturing receives the hash-bound Rev A0 bare-board archive and fixed prototype order parameters; it does not infer PCBA authorization from the presence of PCB fabrication data.

parameters.name: stack
parameters.value: 4 layers, 1.6 mm finished thickness, 1 oz outer copper

parameters.name: specialOptions
parameters.value: tented vias; remove order number; no impedance, gold fingers, castellations or edge plating

flows.failureState: Stop assembly and fabrication release; revise authoritative coordinates or reserved volumes, regenerate the enclosure and rerun geometry plus first-article gates.
Disconnect the battery, preserve current limiting, prohibit further energization and reopen J2/J3 electrical, thermal and physical checks.
Reject the event or target image, close only the affected slot, keep media and every dangerous output inactive, record the failure and reopen host, target and receiver verification.
Stop checkout, preserve the prototype-only boundary, regenerate from the authoritative PCB and re-verify the upload archive and order parameters.

verificationGates.verification: Bound PCB identity matches the frozen Rev A0 source; recorded KiCad ERC is 0 errors/0 warnings, DRC is 0 violations/0 unconnected/0 footprint errors and 23/23 land-pattern tests pass.

Generated printable package matches the authoritative PCB and reports no shell/PCB, shell/battery, carrier/battery, shell/haptic, PCB/haptic or battery/haptic collisions while preserving the power, haptic and RF reservations.
Two host tests pass the eight positive gesture vectors, stationary and cross-axis negatives, physical-arm gate, 250 ms refractory and exact-length non-actuating gesture-event protocol behavior.

The bound receiver host record reports a clean 25/25 build, 8/8 CTest, cppcheck 9/9 selected files with no findings and 37/37 source-hash matches for exact V1/V2 profiles, eight isolated slots, fail-closed runtime, renderer, audio and media scheduling.
The hash-bound archive is the verified upload candidate containing the Rev A0 Gerber/drill set for the fixed bare-PCB order configuration.

Print and measure the first enclosure, select and continuity-check the exact protected battery/J2 harness and haptic part, assemble under current limiting, then record fit, torque, charge, USB, haptic, temperature and RF results.
Build, hash, flash and hardware-in-loop test a NINA-B302 image with a pinned nRF Connect SDK/Zephyr and ARM toolchain; include representative-user gesture and safety timing data.

Complete and independently review the 50.3 x 42.3 mm 4-layer receiver-effects source after power-width, bounded-neckdown, plane-entry, return-path and CPL-origin rework; require zero ERC/DRC/unconnected/parity findings and a newly generated hash-bound bare-board CAM. Prior CAM remains REJECTED.

Build and flash both NINA-B302 targets, then pass real authenticated BLE/AES-CCM interoperability, profile downgrade, replay persistence, timeout, eight-slot isolation, no-dangerous-output, display/audio, fault-mute and safe-state hardware-in-loop tests on physical boards.
Complete and independently review exact BOM supplier/LCSC mapping, substitutions, CPL origin/rotation and assembly DFM before any PCBA order.
All domain, physical, target, receiver, security, RF, PCBA and independent-review gates pass and an explicit owner production authorization changes the release locks.

authorizations.notes: Owner authorization covers prototype bare-PCB fabrication and prototype 3D printing only. Receiver-effects bare-board upload is eligible only after GATE-RECEIVER-PCB-001 passes with a newly hash-bound CAM; all prior receiver CAM is rejected. This does not authorize PCBA or production release.
